_source: Hover cards for the NET panel (Hud.net_help). Short paraphrases of CPR core p.197-207 as distilled in docs/rules/cyber-net.md sections 3.2-3.7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its numbers), page. Ids are Encounter.NET_ACTIONS (plus jack_out_unsafe, fire_turret, held and the dev_<op> rows of data/rules/net_devices.json), Combatant.programs, and the NET Actions header (net_actions).

net_actions.name: NET Actions
net_actions.text: A turn is either one Meat Action or your NET Actions, never both. Your Move Action stays yours either way. Moving between nodes is free.

backdoor.name: Backdoor
backdoor.text: Break a Password: here, the firewall that bars the way deeper. A broken Password stays open until you jack out; knowing the password gets you through without a roll. Access that outlasts the run needs a Virus left at the lowest floor, not in the game yet.

control.name: Control
control.text: Take a Control Node and what hangs off it: cameras, turrets, door locks, lights, elevators. Taking it changes nothing by itself: each thing on it is then worked with its own NET Action (the HELD NODES rows), from anywhere in the NET, each node once a turn. Held cameras feed you what they see. Jacking out drops every node you hold.

eye_dee.name: Eye-Dee
eye_dee.text: Identify a File: what the data is and what it is worth (value 1-5: scrap, routine, useful, valuable, paydata). On a data gig, identifying the target File downloads it and gets the job done.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.text: Map the Architecture as far as your Check reaches, stopping at the first obstruction whose DV beats it. Shows what is there, not the DVs.

zap.name: Zap
zap.text: Every Netrunner's built-in attack, here on the Black ICE in front of you. At 0 REZ the ICE is derezzed.
zap.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 1d6 REZ

slide.name: Slide
slide.text: Get away from one Black ICE: on a success you move to a neighbouring node and it stays where you left it. Once a turn, and only once it has found you.
slide.key: Interface + 1d10 vs ICE PER + 1d10 · -2 per Skunk

cross.name: Cross Socket
cross.text: Step through the socket into the linked site's NET. Progress in each NET is kept. Linked sites are this game's take on reaching another Architecture, not a book Ability.
cross.key: no roll · its Black ICE may be waiting

jack_out.name: Jack Out
jack_out.text: Leave the NET safely. Your Programs leave with you; held Control Nodes are lost. A Kraken's grip blocks it until its next turn.

jack_out_unsafe.name: Unsafe Jack Out
jack_out_unsafe.text: Pull the plug, Kraken or not. Every Black ICE you have met and not derezzed gets its attack on the way out.
jack_out_unsafe.key: each ICE met: its ATK + 1d10 vs your Interface + 1d10

fire_turret.name: Fire Turret
fire_turret.text: Work a turret on a Control Node you hold: it shoots with your own aim. Each node can act once a turn.
fire_turret.key: your REF + the weapon's Skill + 1d10 vs the range DV

held.name: Held Control Node
held.text: You hold this node. Each thing on it is one NET Action to work, from anywhere in the NET; the node acts once a turn, whichever of its rows you use (a turret's FIRE included). The HELD badge marks its devices on the map too.
held.key: no roll: holding it is enough

dev_loop.name: Loop Camera Feed
dev_loop.text: The node's cameras show the site a recording: they stop reporting anyone they see. You keep watching the real feed. Restore it the same way. While you hold the node its cameras feed the crew what they see, looped or not (house rule: watching isn't operating).
dev_loop.key: no roll · all the node's cameras at once (house rule: one camera system)

dev_lock.name: Lock / Unlock Door
dev_lock.text: Throw the door's lock from the NET. Unlocked, anyone walks through. Locked, it swings shut and stays shut to everyone: the guards' keycards don't open a lock you hold (house rule). Jack out and the site has its locks back.
dev_lock.key: no roll · not while someone stands in the doorway

dev_seal.name: Seal / Open
dev_seal.text: Close and lock every door this control works (a vault door, the cells, the shutters, the gates), or open them all. Sealed doors keep everyone out, keycards or not, until you open them or jack out.
dev_seal.key: no roll · one device, all its doors

dev_halt.name: Halt / Run Elevator
dev_halt.text: Stop the elevator car: nobody rides that shaft until you start it again or jack out.

dev_lights.name: Lights Off / On
dev_lights.text: Kill the lights in the rooms these lights serve. Anyone in the dark is harder to spot: -4 to a guard's or camera's Perception.

dev_cut_alarm.name: Cut Alarm Line
dev_cut_alarm.text: Cut the site's alarm line. A guard who calls it in must go by radio alone: help takes twice as long to come (house rule). Restore it the same way.

dev_sprinklers.name: Run Sprinklers
dev_sprinklers.text: Set off the building's sprinklers: anyone on fire indoors is put out.

dev_distract.name: Start Up
dev_distract.text: Kick the machine into life (or page someone over the PA). Unalerted guards near it on its floor turn to look its way, their backs to everything else (house rule).

sword.name: Sword
sword.text: Anti-Program Attacker: cuts Black ICE apart. It deactivates after the attack.
sword.key: ATK 1 · DEF 0 · REZ 0 · Interface + 1 + 1d10 vs ICE DEF + 1d10 · hit: 3d6 REZ to Black ICE (2d6 to other Programs)

armor.name: Armor
armor.text: Defender: lowers the brain damage you take while it is Rezzed. One copy running at a time, each copy once per Netrun.
